<div align="center">

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
MenuText:String menu:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | Int32 | required | Handle of a menu or item. |

**Returns:** The text it was made with or last given.
